problems.title: High-dimensional sphere packing
problems.statement: Estimate the resources required to independently derive new upper bounds on high-dimensional sphere-packing density down to the Cohn–Elkies threshold.

problems.title: Binary and spherical codes
problems.statement: Estimate the resources required to derive exponentially improved bounds on maximum binary-code size at prescribed minimum distance, with analogous high-dimensional spherical-code results.

problems.title: Non-sofic groups
problems.statement: Estimate the resources required to construct and rigorously verify the existence of a non-sofic group.

problems.title: Connes rigidity conjecture
problems.statement: Estimate the resources required to independently derive and verify a counterexample to the conjecture that specified groups are uniquely determined by their von Neumann algebras.

problems.title: Arithmetic circuit complexity
problems.statement: Estimate the resources required to prove new permanent lower bounds for arithmetic circuits and formulas, including an arithmetic-formula lower bound of order n^4/log n.

problems.title: Quantum parallel repetition
problems.statement: Estimate the resources required to prove an exponential parallel-repetition theorem for general two-player quantum games.

problems.title: Closest vector problem
problems.statement: Estimate the resources required to prove polynomial-factor hardness of approximation for the closest vector problem.

problems.title: Ehrhart volume conjecture
problems.statement: Estimate the resources required to determine in every dimension the maximum volume of a convex body whose centroid is its only interior lattice point.

problems.title: Multicolor Ramsey numbers
problems.statement: Estimate the resources required to prove a superexponential lower bound for multicolor triangle Ramsey numbers.

problems.title: Extremal number conjectures
problems.statement: Estimate the resources required to resolve the compactness and degeneracy conjectures in extremal graph theory.
